title: Secure Communications Network
description: A defense agency is establishing a secure communication network consisting of n relay stations numbered from 0 to n - 1. They have a list of bidirectional communication links, where links[i] = [u, v] indicates a link between station u and station v. Determine whether these stations form a valid communication tree, meaning there is exactly one path between any pair of stations and there are no closed loops (cycles).
input_format: An integer n representing the number of stations, and a 2D array links representing the bidirectional connections.
output_format: A boolean value true if the stations form a valid tree, and false otherwise.

examples.explanation: There are 5 stations and 4 links forming a connected acyclic graph, which satisfies the definition of a valid tree.
The links contain a cycle between stations 1, 2, and 3, meaning it is not a valid tree.
A single station with no links is a trivial valid tree.
